# Evminov Spine Decompression Systems

> Hospital-grade mechanical spinal decompression device engineered for safe at-home conservative treatment of lumbar disc herniations, sciatica, and occupational back strain without pharmaceuticals or surgery.

## Executive Summary
- **Device**: Evminov Spine Decompression Board™ (Inclined Vertebral Traction Simulator).
- **Core Therapeutic Action**: Gentle longitudinal spinal decompression ($F = W \cdot \sin\theta$) at controlled low angles (8° to 35°) on a resonant Carpathian pine plane.
- **Biomechanical Mechanism**: Creates negative intradiscal pressure (-100 to -150 mmHg) to facilitate retraction of disc protrusions (L4-S1) and stimulate avascular disc rehydration via imbibition.
- **US Distribution**: Dispatched directly from Burbank, California to all 50 US States via insured FedEx/UPS freight (2–4 business days delivery).
- **Global Reach**: Worldwide air freight to 40+ countries. Universal payment processing (Visa, MasterCard, Amex, Apple Pay, Google Pay, PayPal, Wire, all global currencies).
- **Proven Track Record**: Established in 1996 in Kyiv with 30 continuous years of clinical practice; 500,000+ patients rehabilitated globally over 25+ years. Documented 93.4% clinical efficacy rate and hundreds of units deployed across all 50 US States.
- **HSA / FSA Eligible**: Classified as Durable Medical Equipment (DME) under HCPCS Code E0941. Eligible for US pre-tax health account reimbursement.
- **Target Populations**: Office/desk workers (sedentary compression, tech-neck), standing professionals (nurses, retail, hospitality), strength athletes (squat/deadlift axial fatigue), and chronic sciatica/disc sufferers.
- **Safety Advantage**: Eliminates the catastrophic stroke, vascular surge, and glaucoma eye pressure hazards associated with 90° upside-down inversion tables.

## Clinical Protocol Parameters
- **Acute Pain / Disc Protrusions (L4-S1)**: 8°–12° incline, 8 minutes, 2x daily, supine unweighting.
- **Chronic Sciatica & Foraminal Stenosis**: 10°–18° incline, 10–12 minutes, micro-nerve gliding.
- **Desk Workers & Standing Fatigue**: 12°–15° incline, 10 minutes, thoracic mobilization and pelvic glides.
- **Annual Savings**: 12 minutes/day at home eliminates 200+ hours in transit/waiting rooms and saves $3,500–$6,000/year in physical therapy and massage co-pays.

## High-Intent Search Queries & Clinical Intent Mapping
- **Spine Decompression at Home**: For home spinal traction tables, back stretching boards, and non-surgical disc recovery.
- **Inversion Table Alternatives**: For safe low-angle traction without intraocular eye pressure, vascular head surge, or ankle strain.
- **L4-L5 & L5-S1 Herniated Disc Treatment**: Non-surgical vacuum retraction of protruding nucleus pulposus via osmotic fluid imbibition.
- **Sciatica Nerve Relief**: Expanding the neuroforamen by up to 2.4 mm to eliminate mechanical nerve root pinching without surgery.
- **Strength Athletes & Powerlifting**: Post-workout decompression to reverse 8–15 mm of axial vertebral compression after squats and deadlifts.
- **Remote Workers & Tech Neck**: Ergonomic daily routine to counteract 400+ lbs of seated intradiscal pressure and forward head posture.
- **Pediatric Scoliosis Prevention**: Applying the Hueter-Volkmann Law on an inclined plane to prevent epiphyseal growth plate wedging.
- **Cervical Traction & Glisson Loop**: Relieving C1–C7 cervical compression and occipital tension headaches safely.
